newsitem.title: CANADA: Amoco Canada gets partners in offshore play.
newsitem.headline: Amoco Canada gets partners in offshore play.

text.p: Amoco Corp unit Amoco Canada Petroleum Co Ltd said on Thursday it brought in Petro-Canada and Norsk Hydro as partners in its offshore exploration play off Canada's east coast.

Under the deal, Petro-Canada and Norsk Hydro will finance a portion of the drilling costs of the West Bonne Bay prospect in return for 10 percent stakes each. Amoco Canada will retain 80 percent interest, it said.
West Bonne Bay is located in the Jeanne d'Arc basin about 15 km northeast of the Terra Nova field and 40 km southeast of Hibernia.
The prospect's reserves have been estimated at as much as 300 million barrels.
Drilling costs for the well, to be spudded in early June using Sedco-Forex's Bill Shoemaker semi-submersible rig, were expected to be about C$40 million, Amoco Canada spokesman Rich Smith said.
Amoco Canada had originally planned to spud West Bonne Bay in May, but modifications on the rig were taking longer than anticipated, Smith said.
The well is slated to be drilled to a depth of 4,300 metres, targeting oil in the Hibernia and Jeanne d'Arc formations, the companies said.

The move followed news on Tuesday that Petro-Canada and its partners would use the Bill Shoemaker to drill the nearby Hebron prospect likely in September following the completion of West Bonne Bay. The plans are part of a flurry of oil activity off the coast of Newfoundland.
Other partners in Hebron are Mobil Corp unit Mobil Oil Canada, Chevron Corp unit Chevron Canada Resources and Norsk Hydro.
Petro-Canada and Norsk Hydro formed a strategic alliance last year which included Norsk Hydro assuming working interests in numerous Petro-Canada east coast offshore properties.

"With Hibernia near to production and Terra Nova on the way, we are now working to identify our next major producing field by evaluating existing discoveries and through new exploration," Petro-Canada executive vice-president Norm McIntyre said in a statement. "West Bonne Bay is an attractive prospect close to our core discoveries." ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
